audit_items.proof_trace: The code has two intentional close_factor bypass paths: (1) a bad-debt bypass at L984-992 when collateral_total_value ≤ 1.01×debts_total_value (prevents bad-debt accumulation), and (2) a small-debt bypass at L1006 when the specific DebtType's debt_value ≤ close_factor_bypass_min_value (impractical to enforce 50% close factor on tiny amounts). The property's formal assertion uses total_collateral_value but the code correctly compares debt_value per L1081-1082 comment — this is the intended design. In both bypass cases the collateral seized is bounded by the actual debt being repaid, so no disproportionate loss occurs.
